job.name: l4_host_d4
job.meaning: курьер-велосипедист ~27: спортивный, кудрявый, повязка на лбу, зелёно-белая велоджерси, лямки термо-рюкзака; фон горчичный; живой человек-типаж из сферы доставки (не модель, не сток), фотореализм, однотонный фон палитры «Свежий рынок»; по пояс, по центру, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки; без надписей и логотипов
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a real everyday person with a vivid, recognisable CHARACTER (a memorable type from real life, like a hero of a warm TV commercial — NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock-photo office worker). Vertical 9:16, waist-up, the person in the centre facing the camera, shoulders square, hands out of frame. Expression: lively eyes full of personality, but the face NEUTRAL like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Headroom: top of the head about 16% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and sharp. Colours from the attached board «Свежий рынок» (palette only, do NOT copy the man on it): leaf green #23A455, tomato red #FF4B2E, mustard #FFC531, cream #FFF6E9 — clothes and details use these colours. Background: a plain seamless backdrop in ONE palette colour (given below), bright even daylight-like lighting, natural skin texture, cheerful but natural look. No text, no logos, no brand names, no badges, nothing covering the face. Type: a sporty bicycle delivery courier of about 27, athletic, curly dark hair held by a sweatband, a leaf-green and white cycling jersey, straps of an insulated delivery backpack on his shoulders (no logo), a slight healthy flush after riding. Backdrop: mustard yellow #FFC531.
